correctness.rationale: Exact integration of held acceleration gives F_r(t). The 2x2 Jury inequalities characterize all individually Schur-stable t by 0<t<min(2,2/r). Symbolic multiplication gives 1-T+D=r(a+b)(a+b-ab)>0 and 2(1+T+D)=S_r(a,b), with 1-D>0. For fixed z=ab, (L-a)(L-b)>0 implies a+b<L+z/L, so S_r(a,b)>S_r(L,z/L); every boundary pair can be approached by interior pairs. The edge quadratic has rigorously evaluated minima on all four parameter regimes, proving both the all-pairs property and actual interior unstable witnesses. At r=1,a=3/4,b=7/4, the exact 1+T+D=-71/512. An independent exact-fraction Jury implementation and symbolic identity script passed 9227 rational cases; computation supplements analytic proof, not substitutes for real-parameter quantifiers.

value.rationale: The gain ratio k_p/k_d^2 naturally measures proportional relative to squared derivative feedback strength. The theorem decisively separates ranges where all individually stabilizing sample intervals are safe to alternate from a wide region where periodic jitter alone creates exponential divergence, with a sharp all-real gain frontier and a rational witness. The complete criterion and minimal two-period counterexample complement—not merely rename—single-rate sampled stability or generic conservative robust bounds. The restriction to exact periodic switching is explicit.
